messages:
alex: quick poll — hot afternoon mood. give me a ~45min playlist (no heavy metal) and one short mini-series or movie-ish thing under ~4 hours. go! :sunglasses:
maria: ok i made a 45m "sun porch" mix — mostly indie/soft synth. drop it in case anyone wants to steal:

```
1. Fleet Foxes — Mykonos (3:40)
2. Sufjan Stevens — Should Have Known Better (5:05)
3. Toro y Moi — So Many Details (4:10)
4. The War on Drugs — Strangest Thing (4:20)
5. Snail Mail — Pristine (3:42)
6. Beach House — Space Song (5:20)
7. Khruangbin — White Gloves (5:10)
8. Alvvays — Archie, Marry Me (3:15)
9. Lucy Dacus — Night Shift (5:30)
```

total ~39–45 min depending on versions. cozy, low-key. :leaves:
jamal: mini-series pick: watch "Over the Garden Wall" if you want something short and weird — total runtime ~2 hrs, cartoon but satisfies a single-sitting vibe. perfect for twilight. :maple_leaf:
sophie: or Bandersnatch (Black Mirror) if you want interactive + ~90min. good for napping and making terrible decisions. :video_game:
lina: adding a 10-min bonus chillout at the end: Bon Iver — 715 (slept a wink) to stretch to 45 if you want a wind-down. :zzz:
ben: shoutout to maria, this is exactly my vibe — saving. :thumbsup: also rec: if you want slightly more groove, swap in Khruangbin's "Evan Finds the Third Room" instead of White Gloves.
jukebox-bot: added maria's playlist to #random-playlists (link: https://open.spotify/placeholder) :cd:
maria: oh nice, thanks bot :raised_hands:
alex: love these. quick vote — cartoon (Over the Garden Wall) or interactive (Bandersnatch)? react with :one: for cartoon, :two: for interactive
lina: :one:
ben: :one: :popcorn:
jamal: :two: trying to be contrarian :wink:
sophie: :one: — cartoon wins?
alex: cartoon it is. mini-marathon tonight at 8pm for whoever's around. bring your own tea. :tea:
ben: I'll bring cinnamon cookies.
lina: i'll bring the cozy lamp (and vibes) :bulb:
maria: tagging @all — come if you want, no pressure. small, low-key. :heart:
jukebox-bot: reminder set for 2024-06-02T20:00:00Z — watching Over the Garden Wall with playlist queued. :alarm_clock:
